question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for generic transient tool progress?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but repository policy treats additive Plugin SDK surface as a compatibility commitment that requires explicit maintainer intent rather than an automated reviewer inferring permanence from implementation convenience.

options.title: Accept the generic contract
options.body: Keep the narrow reply-payload symbols as the shared producer-to-channel intent and document their transient-only semantics through tests.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Replace the public export with an internal or owner-local seam before merge, avoiding a new third-party compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow reply-payload symbols as the shared producer-to-channel intent and document their transient-only semantics through tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current Slack delivery architecture and existing progress-kind contract that this PR generalizes.
